Consolidated subsidiaries rose to 15 (from 13): added Nau IB Fund 17 (72.66%, KRW 59,219M, which holds 30.92% of Sun Fluoro System), DNF and Soulbrain NTC; SFS Global liquidated; Sun Fluoro System (Japan coating group with Taiwan, China, Arizona and Korea units) effective stake 64.8%. Board approved a new entity for the Pangyo 2 G2 block on 2026-03-05, a share transfer on 2026-02-19 (subsidiary stake disposal KRW 34,807M), a fund commitment on 2026-02-09 and a new-entity investment on 2026-06-10; 30% joint venture WSCH established 2026-04-28 (KRW 240M). KRW 63,596M convertible bond fully repaid in H1 (CB liability 0 from KRW 85,546M). Credit rating AA from NICE D&B on 2026-05-20 (AA in 2024 and 2025). Shareholder returns: minimum dividend policy KRW 2,000/share (value-up plan); FY2025 dividend KRW 2,350/share (KRW 17,998M, 22.77% payout) paid April 2026; treasury-share trust of KRW 12,000M announced 2026-07-31 (about 53,452 shares, 0.68%, to be bought in 2026), 119,910 treasury shares (1.54%) held. Charter amended 2026-03-24 (revised Commercial Act, shareholder approval of financial statements and dividends); AGM 2026-03-24 re-elected independent director Yang Gil-ho and auditor Park Deok-hyun. Auditor changed to Shinwoo Accounting for 2026-2028 (periodic designation). Chief researcher Choi Kyung-se promoted to president (central research institute) in 2026. R&D H1 KRW 19,119M (4.22% of separate sales; FY2025 4.44%); pipeline framed around special etchants for sub-2nm GAA, next-generation CMP slurry and precursors for HBM4 stacking, TSV plating additives and planarisation materials for HBM4/chiplet, and glass-substrate processing materials for next-generation packaging. Share price: Jan 2026 low KRW 277,000, Mar 2026 high KRW 501,000, June 2026 KRW 324,000-441,500 (2026-06-30 close KRW 365,500; H1 TSR 32%).

quarterly_data.signal: AI / HBM / ADVANCED PACKAGING framing in the half-year report (2026-08-14): the company says the surge in AI semiconductor demand has raised the importance of HBM and advanced-packaging processes, pushing up the technical barrier for high-purity chemicals and precision polishing materials; the global semiconductor market is growing at an unprecedented pace on AI data-center memory and on-device AI, and the introduction of sub-2nm GAA processes and volume production of 300+ layer V-NAND are driving continued demand for high-performance etchants and next-generation precursors. Seasonality has flattened because AI and cloud enterprise demand now leads, producing a longer up-cycle. Product positioning: special etchants for sub-2nm GAA, next-generation CMP slurry and precursors for HBM4 stacking; ultra-high-purity chemicals supplied at near-exclusive levels to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix from the leading-edge ramp and ultra-high-layer V-NAND development stage; a completed portfolio of TSV formation and planarisation materials for HBM4 and chiplet structures to lift high-value-added revenue; display unit expanding into glass-substrate processing materials for next-generation packaging; customers' processes moving to GAA and to HBM / 400+ layer NAND, with joint development from the process-design stage. US entities Soulbrain TX LLC (2022) and Soulbrain RASA TX LLC (2024) respond in real time to customers' new fab lines in Texas and North America; the Xi'an entity supports China memory lines. Semiconductor material ASPs +5% vs FY2025 while raw-material costs rose +14%; semiconductor materials 85% of H1 revenue, +31% company-wide revenue growth.
